title: Expanded gradient color range
slide_intent: Explore variation within a recognizable color structure so a brand can change mood without losing continuity.
strategic_value: A blue-led gradient family can give O2 more expressive range across its digital communications.
demonstration: The full-frame gradient changes from pale blue and white to deep blue with cyan, pink and warm lower accents.
practical_value: Compare light and saturated variants to choose a mood while preserving the blue connection.

content_islands.name: Continuous color field
content_islands.spec: Use the entire frame for a soft gradient with no type, borders or other objects.

content_islands.name: Color sequence
content_islands.spec: Move through pale, deep-blue and warm-accented states without introducing hard color boundaries.

ingredient.name: Blue gradient family
ingredient.role: Provide atmospheric variation around a recurring blue reference.
ingredient.application: Use soft transitions between blue and the accent colors illustrated in the sequence.
ingredient.scope: A palette-expression study from the 2023 case study, not a swatch specification or quantified usage rule.

reference_purposes.Intent: The surrounding source heading says the color work adds flexibility to the brand.
reference_purposes.Expression: The moving field demonstrates the range from pale blue to saturated blue with warm accents.
